text.en: Concrete alone is strong enough in tension for most structural members; steel reinforcement is just an extra margin of safety, not something concrete actually needs to avoid failing at low load -- in reality, plain concrete's tensile strength is only roughly a tenth of its compressive strength, so an unreinforced concrete beam cracks and fails on its tension side at a small fraction of the load it could carry in pure compression -- reinforcement is what allows the member to actually resist bending loads at all.
text.et: Puhas betoon on enamiku konstruktsioonielementide jaoks piisavalt tugev tõmbes; teraskarkass on lihtsalt lisaturvavaru, mitte miski, mida betoon tegelikult vajaks madala koormuse juures purunemise vältimiseks -- tegelikult on puhta betooni tõmbetugevus vaid ligikaudu kümnendik selle survetugevusest, mistõttu sarrustamata betoontala praguneb ja puruneb oma tõmbepoolel murdosa koormuse juures, mida see puhta surve all kanda suudaks -- sarrus on see, mis võimaldab elemendil üldse painutuskoormustele vastu seista.
